$comment: MCP diff_facts argument schema (org-memory HTTP adapter).

predicate.description: Registry predicate key; omit to diff all predicates for the subject.

as_of_from.description: World-time start of the snapshot pair (exclusive with belief pair).

as_of_to.description: World-time end of the snapshot pair; must be after as_of_from.

believed_as_of_from.description: Belief-time start of the snapshot pair (exclusive with world pair).

believed_as_of_to.description: Belief-time end of the snapshot pair; must be after believed_as_of_from.

as_of_grain.description: World-time grain applied to both as_of snapshots.
